question: **Which of the following is an ideal way of handling a difficult situation? **

options.text: Becoming overcome by stress and negativity
Thinking deeply about the impact of adversities
Making the best use of a situation to your advantage

solution:
The correct answer is: **Making the best use of a situation to your advantage **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The first sentence of the second paragraph in the given passage states that- *"The distinguishing feature of the successful is that they have a mind-set that enables them to remain positive__ in the face of adversity and even __utilise the negative situation for their benefit__.**"*
 
• That means "**The ability to remain optimistic in the face of difficulty and even turn adversity to their advantage is what separates the successful from the unsuccessful.**"
 
• The given passage also focuses that **"Obstacles and challenges have a positive side because they force us to develop internally. With friction, a gem is polished. By burning it, steel is transformed into the finest steel. Similar to this, we grow stronger the more challenges we encounter."**

From here we can conclude that option 4 is the right answer.
